d.title: One Piece: Yume no Soccer Ou!
d.jp: ワンピース 夢のサッカー王!
syn: One Piece: Soccer King of Dreams
d.synopsis: Luffy and his crew take on the Villain All-Stars in a game of soccer in order to become the Dream Soccer King. The game comes down to a pk tie-breaker shoot-out with Coby as goalie and Helmeppo refereeing.
